instructions: Choose one pointer input and one keyboard input independently for the next second from the latest screenshot. They execute together, so a key may be held while the pointer action occurs. Use visible targets and the actual input history.

pointer.instructions: Choose one mouse action. Menus and buttons are operated with the left click. Waiting is appropriate only when no mouse action is useful or during visible loading and transitions.

walk_to_target.description: Left-click a visible menu option or button, or the visible destination where the goose should walk next.

use_beak_on_target.description: Right-click the visible object or target the goose should use its beak on next.

aim_at_target.description: Move the pointer to a visible object or direction to aim the goose's head without clicking.

no_pointer.description: Do not move or click the pointer this step.

keyboard.instructions: Choose one keyboard input independently. It is held during the pointer action selected above.

bend_neck.description: Hold Control to lower and extend the goose's neck.

flap.description: Hold X to flap the wings.

show_tasks.description: Hold Tab to display the in-game task list.

no_key.description: Hold no keyboard key this step.
